meta.name: mcp-server
meta.description: Configure, launch, validate, and troubleshoot CCAM's comprehensive MCP server for Claude Code, Codex, and other MCP hosts. Use when installing dependencies, building the server, selecting stdio, HTTP, or REPL transport, setting mutation/destructive policy, supplying dashboard authentication, or checking complete tool registration.

copy.tagline: 把 CCAM 的工具服务器配置好并排除故障,让 AI 编程助手顺利调用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你需要让 Claude Code 等 AI 助手连接并使用 CCAM 的各项工具。
copy.tagline_en: Configure and troubleshoot CCAM's tool server so AI coding assistants can use it.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to set up and debug CCAM's server for Claude Code or other AI hosts.

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 能帮你搭建和运行一个“MCP 服务器”后台程序：它会自动安装依赖、构建代码，并以三种方式之一启动；你还可以让它设置数据读写权限、检查所有功能是否就绪。
howto.when: 当你要安装依赖、构建服务器或选择传输方式等 MCP 服务器相关操作时触发。

say.text: 帮我安装依赖并构建 MCP 服务器。
用 stdio 方式启动 MCP 服务器。
say.note: 执行 ccam mcp stdio 命令。

say.text: 检查 MCP 服务器是否配置正确。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude install, build, launch, and validate a dedicated MCP server. It supports stdio, HTTP, and REPL transports, and can set data-access policies and authentication tokens, then verify all tools are registered.
howto.when_en: Use when installing dependencies, building the server, choosing a transport (stdio, HTTP, etc.), or performing related configuration and verification tasks.

say_en.text: Install dependencies and build the MCP server.
say_en.note: Runs npm run mcp:install and mcp:build.

say_en.text: Start the MCP server with stdio transport.
